critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_reproduced_174k: Fundamental tradeoff persists at 174k: Citation-based (LangDom PASS, Jurist PASS, CiteHeritage FAIL) vs Text-based (LangDom FAIL, Jurist FAIL, CiteHeritage AUC PASS but recall@10 FAIL). Production default cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 is best citation-based: LangDom=0.477, Jurist=0.735, CiteHeritage AUC=0.760.
critical_findings.citation_heritage_negative_174k: ALL 8 TF-IDF representations FAIL citation_heritage at 174k (recall@10 < 0.2 threshold). Best recall@10: full_text_tfidf_light=0.052, cited_decisions_tfidf=0.044. Citation graph pair pool covers 2,936 unique decisions (~1.69% of 173,963). Citation-independent retrieval near-zero for citation signals; text signals achieve AUC 0.85-0.90 at smaller scale but collapse on adversarial gates at full scale.
critical_findings.v17b_label_normalization_174k: 49.3% labels normalized (85,819/173,963, 214->164 unique areas). CORRECTED per audit CYCLE_36527630008: Citation-based reps show modest purity gains (3-10%, 1.03-1.10x) across hierarchy/zoom_fine/legal_area. Text-based reps show significant degradation on zoom_fine (16-34% loss, 0.66-0.84x), hierarchy/legal_area roughly stable (~1.0x). NMI metrics show modest degradation for both families. regeste_tfidf is the only representation satisfying no-worsening on ALL hierarchy metrics. Prior report overstated gains by ~10x. Differential effect REPRODUCED across 4 seeds and re-verified 2026-09-28.
critical_findings.v6_dense_12k_evaluation: V6 dense embeddings (years 2000-2002, 12,570 decisions) evaluated with v25 formal suite: 7 PASS / 3 FAIL / 2 SKIP. CRITICAL: adversarial_falsification FAIL (language_dominance=0.99, branch_coherence=0.99) - language completely dominates neighbors. hierarchy_coherence FAIL (purity=0.42 < 0.7, nmi=0.59). legal_area_clustering FAIL (purity=0.009 << 0.5). PASS: branch_knn (0.996), tf_metadata (0.996), multilingual_invariance (sep=0.076), cross_language_pairs (sep=0.076), collapse_check (mean_sim=0.86), temporal_stability (std=0.0), zoom_coherence (improvement=50%). V17b normalization: NO improvement (purity unchanged, NMI drops). Confirms dense scale dependency: at 12k, dense embeddings cluster by language not law.
critical_findings.adversarial_benchmarks_hnsw_artifact_fix: Exact k-NN on stratified subsample (n=2000, seed=42) confirms HNSW artifact fix. 5/8 reps PASS both gates. Production default confirmed PASS (LangDom=0.477, Jurist=0.735). V25 suite uses HNSW with fixed params (M=16, ef_construction=200, ef_search=100) for scalability; citation_heritage uses exact k-NN on valid subset.
critical_findings.dense_scale_dependency: Dense embeddings FAIL adversarial gates at 12k (LangDom~0.98-1.0), TF-IDF citation-based PASS at 174k. Dense PASS cross-language transfer (zero-shot NMI~0.46-0.48) and cluster coherence (branch_purity~0.89) at 12k. Root cause: 18.3% metadata coverage, partial corpus center-projection, raw multilingual-e5 language clustering at 12k vs full 174k TF-IDF. V6 dense 12k confirms: LangDom=0.99 at 12k. Extended to 15-year partial (2000-2014): same failure pattern.
critical_findings.boilerplate_resistance_negative: All TF-IDF reps FAIL boilerplate resistance (resistance_score ≈ -0.57 to -0.84) - confirms language dominance/cross-lingual alignment failure, not procedural boilerplate.
critical_findings.hierarchy_coherence_low: All TF-IDF reps FAIL Jurivoc proxy (level_0_nmi < 0.3, level_1_nmi < 0.2). Best level_1_nmi: full_text_tfidf_light=0.030 (but FAIL adversarial). Dense at 12k: level_1_nmi ~0.59-0.68 but purity very low (0.42).
critical_findings.temporal_stability_mixed: full_text_tfidf_light PASS (0.78 overlap), others FAIL (0.0-0.38). V6 dense 12k PASS (std=0.0 - suspiciously perfect). Scale stability remains challenging.
